text:
Eve (PM): Putting together copy & flows for the API Keys page. Quick review pls — focus on create/rotate/revoke, permissions, empty states, a11y. Here's current modal copy: 'Create new API key — this key will be shown once. Store it safely.' Thoughts?
Mike (Design): Love the one-time reveal line. Suggest tweak: 'This key can only be viewed once — make a secure copy now.' Add an explicit 'Download .env' button, and put the 'reveal' affordance left of the key so it reads top-to-bottom.
Sara (Front-End): Implementation note: we never persist plaintext. We only show once. I'd like an 'I understand' checkbox before we reveal to reduce accidental copies. Also prefer copy button + toast rather than auto-select.
Josh (Security): Make the rotate flow audit-log heavy. When rotating, keep old key valid for a short grace period (default 5m) and show a banner: 'Old key valid until 15:23 UTC' so customers can swap. Require owner role for revokes and log the actor. Consider requiring MFA for rotation in orgs with >50 seats.
Anya (UX): Empty state idea: show explainer + CTA 'Create first key' and 3 short examples (embeddings, inference, webhooks) with suggested scopes. For accessibility, ensure icons have alt text and the primary CTA has clear focus state.
Eve (PM): @Mike can we add permission granularity in the create modal? e.g., scope toggles (embeddings:read/write, inference:read) and expiry (never / 30d / custom). Include a short 'why least privilege matters' note.
Mike (Design): Yes. Visual approach: use selectable pills for scopes, inline info icons that open small a11y-friendly popovers. Flag admin-level scopes in a red outline and show a confirm step 'You are granting admin access'. For rotate modal show a small timeline illustrating grace overlap.
Sara (Front-End): Keyboard/a11y checklist: modal must trap focus, Esc closes, Copy button reachable by tab, aria-live announces: 'API key created. Key revealed below. This will not be shown again.' Also ensure color contrast for pills.
Josh (Security): Add a 'revoke all' capability for emergency, and per-user token view in audit logs. Also expose last-used timestamp in the keys list. For high-risk orgs, default to 'require MFA to rotate/revoke'.
Anya (UX): Copy tweak for revoke confirmation: change 'Are you sure?' to 'Revoking this key will immediately stop all services using it. This action cannot be undone.' Add a typed confirmation (type the key name) for admin-scoped keys.
Eve (PM): UX copy for the reveal banner: 'This key is displayed only once. Download or copy it now — we cannot show it again.' Also add a small 'how to rotate' link next to each key row.
DeployBot: Feature flag 'api_keys_v2' rolled out to 20% of beta orgs (deploy 1742001289).
Mike (Design): I'll mock the modal with scope toggles, expiry control, rotate timeline banner, and accessible popovers. Will also ensure colorblind-friendly palette and larger hit targets.
Sara (Front-End): I'll add aria-live for the reveal, focus trap, and an e2e test for copy/rotation flows. Quick question: do we want to store key names/summaries in plaintext or only hashed? @Josh
Josh (Security): Store only hashes + metadata. We keep a hashed fingerprint for lookup, plus last-used and created-by. Rotation creates a new secret and hashes the old one for audit. We'll spec the grace period default 5m but make it configurable per org.
Eve (PM): Next steps: @Mike deliver mocks by EOD Fri, @Sara spike modal behaviors and accessibility tests, @Josh draft security spec with MFA/role gating, @Anya update empty-state copy & examples. I'll update the product brief and link here when ready. Thanks all!
